default.$description: Primary brand colour. In Dark, Purple 500 mixed 62% with Grey 50, so it reads on the Black page and takes a dark label.

hover.$description: Primary brand colour on hover. In Light it darkens, in Dark it lightens: both raise the label contrast.

action.$description: Resting fill of button-like controls: none, so the container shows through.

selected.$description: Fill of a selected button-like control: the primary selected colour at 10%, the same contrast with the page in both themes.

action.$description: Label of button-like controls. Grey 100 in Dark keeps the Light contrast with the page.

selected.$description: Label of a selected button-like control: the primary selected colour.

action.$description: Boundary of button-like controls: the control border mixed with the background, 70% in Light and 42% in Dark, the same contrast with the page in both themes.

selected.$description: Boundary of a selected button-like control: the selection colour mixed with the background, 70% in Light and 51% in Dark, the same contrast with the page in both themes.

default.$description: Label on the primary fill: White in Light, Black in Dark, where the primary fill is light.

Label on a solid selected fill, the same as the label on the primary fill.
